1.alt_img: Screenshot of the JSONSortFlow sorting visualizer
1.title: JSONSortFlow
1.description: The backend API I built behind this visualizer — containerized endpoints that stream step-by-step Bubble, Merge, and Quick Sort operations to the frontend.

2.title: Pathfinding Visualizer
2.description: The backend API I built behind this visualizer — endpoints for A*, BFS, DFS, and Dijkstra that stream each search step to an interactive maze grid.

3.alt_img: Terminal-style placeholder for the Win64-httpdLite HTTP server
3.title: Win64-httpdLite
3.description: A minimal HTTP/1.1 server written from scratch in x86-64 assembly (MASM) for Windows — no framework, just Winsock and raw socket handling.

4.alt_img: Terminal-style placeholder for the Win64-echod echo server
4.title: Win64-echod
4.description: A tiny TCP echo server implemented in x86-64 assembly (MASM) on Windows — a deep dive into low-level networking with Winsock.

5.alt_img: Quadtree collision visualization showing spatial partitioning
5.title: Quadtree Collision
5.description: Rust + WebAssembly (wasm-bindgen, wasm-pack) with vanilla JavaScript + Canvas2D — no frameworks or bundlers. Dynamic QuadTree accelerates boids flocking and elastic collisions for up to 10k particles at 60 FPS via zero-copy WASM memory.
